title: BiasCause: Evaluate Socially Biased Causal Reasoning of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses and generated causal reasoning graphs against open-ended questions, as well as using name-based substitution (feminine vs. masculine) for job/major recommendation and personality derivation tasks.
